crossRefs.note: “ ‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her…
There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of…

translations.web: “ ‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
translations.bsb: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.
translations.kjv: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
translations.asv: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
